text:
maya: Heads up — seeing a spike where projectless API keys route to the fallback GPU pool in prod dashboard, latency up ~30ms
liam: Can you paste the sample trace ids? wondering if it's routing or a capacity blip
maya: trace ids: 7f9a2c, 7f9a2d, 7f9a30. snippet from router logs:
```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z router: key_id=kp_abc123, origin=unattributed, chosen_pool=fallback-gpu, reason=policy:ambient
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z router: key_id=kp_def456, origin=org-42, chosen_pool=primary-gpu
```
liam: ok looks like policy matched ambient path for keys without project claim
sara: this is the sampling/telemetry artifact we've seen — if attribution sampler hasn't run, key shows as projectless and hits fallback. billing attribution later reconciles but UX/dashboard shows the spike
devex: the console shows "Unattributed keys" metric with that big jump, but users keep asking where the cost came from. confusing for customers and SREs
anton: short-term fix: prefer org-bound allocation when X-Origin-Org header present even if key has no project claim. longer term: surface attribution state in the routing decision to telemetry so we can correlate faster
liam: i like the header heuristic, but we need a safety net: if header is present but org not allowed for key, fall back and emit event `routing:header-org-mismatch`
maya: +1. also can we emit a `key_attribution_state` tag in traces with values [attributed, pending-sample, fallback]? that'll make dashboard graphs clearer
sara: agreed. adding new tag will let alerts use the right signal instead of raw pool counts
devex: UI idea: show a tiny banner on pool dashboard when >10% of traffic is pending attribution: "Some requests are using fallback routing due to attribution sampling — see docs" and link to troubleshoot steps
liam: rollout plan: patch router + telemetry in canary (10% of traffic) with new tag, then enable header heuristic behind feature flag. measure attribution mismatch rate, latency delta, and billing metric alignment
anton: i'll own the feature-flag and canary gating. can we add a fast alert: if fallback routing > 15% and attribution_pending_rate > 5% for 5m, page eng-sre?
maya: i'll be oncall for the canary window tomorrow 09:00-12:00 PT. i'll watch traces and p99
ops-bot: Deployed: router v2.14.3 to canary cluster (tag: canary/ambient-routing-20260321) :rocket:
sara: thanks — i'll update the dashboard panels with the new tags and add the banner copy in a PR to docs
devex: i can prototype the small UX hint and flag toggle in Console (toggle key: feature.attribution_heuristic)
liam: sweet. quick checklist: (1) router emits `key_attribution_state` (2) header-heuristic behind flag (3) telemetry event `routing:header-org-mismatch` (4) dashboard panels + banner (5) canary alerting/owner assigned
anton: noted. i'll open the PRs and link them here
maya: thanks all. ping here if any canary anomalies, otherwise we'll promote after 24h stable
sara: :thumbsup:
